make a function called is_palindrome takes s returns result
  let n = s.length
  let i = 0
  let j = n - 1
  let ok = true
  while (i < j) and ok do
    if s[i] != s[j] then
      let ok = false
    end
    let i = i + 1
    let j = j - 1
  end
  return ok
end
